other_conditions: Monthly income must be less than ₹10,000 in rural areas or less than ₹12,000 in urban areas
Family land holding must be less than 3 acres of wetland or less than 10 acres of dry land, or a combined total of less than 10 acres
Applicant must not have a built‑up shop larger than 5 × 5 sq ft
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 at 0 % interest for eligible hawkers, street vendors and artisans.
